search_notes: Isolated Hermes Agent run using gpt-6-luna with xhigh reasoning and web tools.

Focused searches found reporting for the listed customer relationships and AWS's overall customer prominence, but not a reliable, period-specific disclosure establishing AWS's rank specifically among customers for AI high-power cables. Research stopped at the tool-call iteration limit.
The named-customer evidence is predominantly secondary reporting, not an issuer disclosure confirming each named relationship in a single dated list.
Customer status and shipment scale vary by period; Microsoft is specifically described as a small-volume shipper in 2025.
Some reports call AWS the largest customer overall, while the claim scopes the ranking to AI high-power lines. Those scopes are not interchangeable.
No source located establishes the denominator or comparative customer data needed to verify the product-specific AWS ranking.
